name: Cleanliness
overview: Scripture emphasizes cleanliness not only in physical terms but also in spiritual purity, as seen in the call to avoid bodily markings and maintain holiness within the camp because the LORD walks among His people (Leviticus 19:28; Deuteronomy 23:12-14). The regulations for hygiene, such as covering waste outside the camp, underscore the importance of outward cleanliness reflecting inward holiness. Psalm 51 expresses a deeper longing for internal cleansing, asking God to create a clean heart and renew a right spirit, highlighting the figurative dimension of cleanliness as a matter of spiritual renewal.
